field_encodings.text_lines_nfc: ordered array of one or two NFC strings, exactly as rendered and without line separators
field_encodings.line_break_sequence: ordered array containing one literal ASS \\N token between each adjacent pair of text_lines_nfc; empty for one line
field_encodings.anchor_x_px: integer output-frame pixel coordinate after deterministic policy rounding
field_encodings.anchor_y_px: integer output-frame pixel coordinate after deterministic policy rounding
field_encodings.rendered_alpha_bbox_px: integer x/y/width/height bounding the non-zero rendered subtitle alpha
field_encodings.vietsub_alpha_mask: complete immutable common.schema.json ObjectRef projection; its sha256 is the digest of the referenced alpha-mask bytes
field_encodings.renderer_binding_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact renderer component/runtime binding record
field_encodings.vietsub_style_policy_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact vietsub_style_policy.json bytes used for rendering

rule: Field order above documents the exact projection; RFC8785 determines object-key serialization order. Unknown or omitted semantic fields create a different contract version rather than being silently hashed.
